finite_certificate.coefficient_convention: All polynomial coefficient lists are ascending. Basis coefficients use b_0=1 and b_j=S_j(t)=zeta_p^j+zeta_p^(-j), 1<=j<n. Matrices have row i and column j equal to coefficient of T^i in g(T)T^j mod F_p(T).
finite_certificate.method: Unconditional Minkowski bound, complete small-prime-orbit enumeration, exact integer norm determinants. No GRH, class-field analytic bounds, precomputed class group, paid proof or unit-regulator computation.

principal_generators.origin: New sparse-vector discovery; exact norm verified by integer resultant and independently by integer multiplication determinant.
